summary_en: City Index Fifth Co., Ltd. launched a tender offer for all investment units of Sankei Real Estate Investment Corporation at 125,000 yen per unit, with a minimum purchase target of 118,732 units (45.0% ownership including special related parties' stakes). The investment corporation's board approved the offer and adopted a neutral stance on unit holders' participation.
title_en: Notice Regarding Expression of Support and Neutral Stance on Public Tender Offer for Investment Units of Sankei Real Estate Investment Corporation (Securities Code: 2972) by City Index Fifth Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
City Index Fifth Co., Ltd. (established October 2012 and engaged in holdings, management, and investment of securities) initiated a public tender offer for all investment units of Sankei Real Estate Investment Corporation on September 25, 2026. The offer price was set at 125,000 yen per unit, with a minimum purchase target of 118,732 units. The minimum purchase target amount represented 45.0% ownership including the offeror's special related parties' stakes, calculated against 467,099 total issued units as of February 28, 2026, from which no treasury units were deducted. The tender offer period ran for 30 business days from September 28 to November 10, 2026.

The investment corporation's board of officers approved the tender offer on the same date, approving the offeror's intention to acquire all investment units and delist the corporation from public markets. The board expressed support for the offer while adopting a neutral stance on whether unit holders should participate, delegating the decision to investors. The board resolution was approved by all directors without conflicts of interest, and no direct capital or personnel relationships existed between the offeror and the investment corporation, though the offeror's special related parties held 139,646 units representing 29.90% ownership as of September 25, 2026.
